metadata.creator: Micah Wright
metadata.description: Constant Payne is a 2001 American animated children's sci-fi action television pilot directed by Micah Wright.  The film revolves around a young girl who is set to inherit the responsibilities of her crime-fighting hero family.  Constant Payne was made for Nickelodeon in 2001, but never aired.
